top_apps.name: Tiny Star Catcher
top_apps.description_short: Tiny Star Catcher is a tug-of-war competitive mobile game
top_apps.description_excerpt: Tiny Star Catcher is a vertical tug-of-war competitive mobile game that combines alternating left and right tapping with rhythm-based reactions. A rope stretches across the centre of the screen, with a golden marker moving back and forth between the player and the opponent; players must quickly tap alternately in the left and right areas at the bottom, each tap pulling the marker one space towards their side. Scoring is achieved by pulling it past the left scoring line, after which the knot resets for another round. The opponent constantly applies force, dragging the marker towards the right red line, and as the score increases, the pull gets stronger, leaving the player with less reaction time. Accidentally tapping the same side or losing rhythm will cause the marker to slide towards the opponent, and crossing their territory means losing. The game features satisfying feedback like particle splashes, ripple flashes, and floating "+1" prompts, with vibrations for mistakes and game over, and supports pausing, restarting, and leaderboard challenges. 《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

top_apps.name: 2-Way Pass
top_apps.description_short: Guide two linked blocks, avoid obstacles, and complete the pass!
top_apps.description_excerpt:
2-Way Pass is a unique and challenging casual puzzle game that tests your timing, coordination, and precision.
Control two connected blocks moving simultaneously across the screen. Your objective is to guide them through obstacles and successfully swap their positions before time runs out. Every move affects both blocks, so careful planning and quick reactions are the keys to success.

top_apps.description_short: SP666RapaCity is a fast-food meal mobile game
top_apps.description_excerpt: SP666RapaCity is a vertical fast-food serving mobile game that combines order matching with fast-click gameplay.
